Maya CSM: Heads-up — SeaBlue Health wants a short pilot next week across US/EU/APAC. Needs temporary allowlist, small APAC routing share (3-7%), and a soft quota bump for the demo. Can we confirm config + auto-revoke?
Jiro Net: Need CIDRs and contact to validate PoP. We usually do 72h TTL for demo ACLs.
Maya CSM: CIDRs: 18.197.32.0/22 and 150.95.0.0/16. HTTPS only. Demo window: 2026-06-02 09:00-11:00 UTC. Expected steady ~80rps, spikes to 280 for ~10-20m.
Omar Ops: We can set weighted route: apac 5%, rest 95%. Quota plan: soft 180rps, hard 500rps during window, autorevoke 2026-06-02T12:00:00Z. Will attach runbook and pager thresholds.
Bea CS: Account flagged for renewal check in 30 days. Customer expects p50/p95 screenshots and sample trace ids. Avoid any 5xx during demo.
Rui ML: Recommend a fallback to q4-8bit for costy tails. Rule: if p95 > 600ms OR cost/1k tokens > $0.55, route to quantized variant. Pre-warm KV cache.
Jiro Net: Allowlist snippet to push (auto-expire):
```
- name: seablue-demo-allow
  cidrs:
    - 18.197.32.0/22
    - 150.95.0.0/16
  ports: [443]
  expires_at: 2026-06-05T09:00:00Z
```
infra-bot: ACL seablue-demo-allow staged for validation (id: acl-f2d). No conflicts found.
Omar Ops: Rate config example: `rate_window:60s; baseline:80rps; burst:320rps; autorevoke:2026-06-02T12:00:00Z`. Alert: sustained >220rps for 4m pages oncall.
Bea CS: I'll send the enablement doc with warmup tokens and sample prompts, and schedule a pre-demo dry run on 2026-06-01 18:00 UTC.
Sam AM: Noted for renewal team. If demo meets SLOs we'll propose dedicated evaluation. Capture cost vs hosted delta.
Maya CSM: Action items: Jiro push ACL + infra PR; Omar set quota & weighted route for account O-55021; Rui add quantized fallback; Bea run enablement and dry-run. Goal: zero throttles, clear metrics for execs. :white_check_mark:
